Maya Chen: Quick one — Kenji (on my squad, SG-based) landed back from a family trip and now needs to isolate for 5 days due to a positive household exposure. A few of those days overlap with our year-end blackout and also with Singapore's public holiday (Dec 31). Can we let him swap the public holiday or advance PTO for the isolation days?
Diego (People Ops): Hi Maya — sorry to hear that. For international offices we treat local public holidays as separate; the blackout applies to discretionary PTO only. If his isolation includes a public holiday, that day remains the public holiday (no PTO needed). For the remaining isolation days that fall in the blackout, we can offer either an advance PTO (to be repaid over next 3 months) or an unpaid emergency leave.
Maya Chen: Good to know re: public holiday. He prefers to keep paid time if possible. Is there a limit on advance PTO for contractors vs full-time?
Suki (Payroll): Contractors: we can only advance up to 3 days (policy). Full-time: up to 7 days advance PTO is allowed for medical/isolation with manager sign-off. Payroll needs written manager approval + employee confirmation of repayment terms to process the advance.
Kenji: I'm full-time, thanks. I can take the 2 isolation days after Dec 31 + Dec 30 is inside blackout. Maya — are you ok approving?
Maya Chen: Approved. Kenji please fill the "Emergency Advance PTO" form: https://intranet.redwood/hr/forms/adv-pto and attach proof of isolation (screenshot of gov notice or test result).
Diego (People Ops): Policy snippet: ```
Emergency Advance PTO (International): For verified isolation, up to 7 days of paid PTO may be advanced to full-time employees. Advances are recovered from future accruals over up to 3 months. Requests during year-end blackout require manager sign-off + documentation + payroll processing note.```
Kenji: Uploaded the gov isolation notice to the form and confirmed repayment over 2 months.
HR-Bot: Created ticket HR-2026-899 for Kenji (APAC) — attaching form and gov doc.
Suki (Payroll): Thanks Kenji. Well queue the advance — expect processing in 2 business days. Note: for APAC team members, payroll must check local payroll tax rules; for Singapore this is treated as normal PTO (no tax impact). If youd moved to unpaid leave, different withholding could apply.
Maya Chen: Thanks — can you cc me when processed? He needs to confirm travel/home logistics.
Suki (Payroll): Will do, Maya. Ill update the ticket once posted.
Diego (People Ops): One more note for managers: if someone repeatedly needs isolation advances, escalate to People Ops for a longer-term accommodation (work-from-home, schedule flexibility).
Kenji: Really appreciate the quick turnaround everyone. :pray:
Maya Chen: Thanks team. Closing loop once payroll confirms. :thumbsup:
